Date June 12, 1932

Subject (in full) Attached file re Yu Lee Zien, alleged opium smuggler.

Made by D.S. Utkin Forwarded by Supt. Quayle

Sir,

With reference to the attached file, enquiries were made
by C.D.S. 76 who ascertained the following:-

The man Yu Lee Zien (于禮泉) 60, Tientsin, was located
by the above detective to be residing in house No. 18, Lane
1051 (Zu Foh Lee 傳福里) off Sinza Road, where he occupies
with his wife and one son the ground floor.

He removed to the above address about 6 years ago from
Burkill Road. Yu Lee Zien had been formerly connected with
the local office of the Hang Yi Bing (漢冶萍) Iron Factory,
Hupeh, but resigned a number of years ago owing to his bad
health. The financial condition of this man is reported to
be not good.

Yu is an opium smoker and has a pipe for his own use.

One named Zung (程) is residing with his family on the
1st floor at the same address but there is nothing to indicate
that this man is engaged in the opium business.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently

事由（全称） 附卷关于涉嫌鸦片走私犯于禮泉（Yu Lee Zien）。

由 侦探长 Utkin 呈报 经 奎尔（Quayle）巡官转呈

先生：

关于所附档案，经刑事侦缉股第76号侦探调查，查明如下情况：

该男子于禮泉（Yu Lee Zien），60岁，天津人，被上述侦探查得居住在新闸路1051弄（传福里 Zu Foh Lee）18号，他与其妻子及一个儿子占用该处底层。

他约于6年前从伯基路（Burkill Road）搬至上述地址。于禮泉此前曾供职于湖北汉冶萍（Hang Yi Bing）铁厂驻沪办事处，但因健康不佳，已于数年前辞职。据报此人经济状况不佳。

于某系鸦片吸食者，并备有烟具供个人使用。

一名姓程（Zung）的男子携家眷居住在同一地址的二楼，但并无迹象表明此人从事鸦片生意。

此致
敬礼

12 Yu Ching Li,
May 18th, 1932.

Sir,
I beg to report that Yu Lu Zien, opium smuggler, native
of Tientsin, age 65 and residing at 1101 Sinza Road. He s
secretly keep a lot of opium in the box. Sometimes there
are opium smokers. If you are going to raid the premises
I would suggest to have it executed at night time and by the
rear door. Yu is working with Han-Ya-Ping Coal Coy. and
the opium comes from the upper river. His son works in the
Bureau of Public Health who solicits many patronizers.

(Sgd.) Chiao Ching Chi alias Tsz Nan,
Member of the China Anti-Opium Association

The newspaper as marked by red ink denotes the
method of opium suppression in a cable answer of Kao
Yu Tong to Anti-Opium Association.

12 余庆里，
1932年5月18日。

先生：
谨此报告，鸦片走私犯于魯泉（Yu Lu Zien），天津籍，年龄65岁，居住于新闸路1101号。他在箱中秘密藏有大量鸦片。有时会有鸦片吸食者前来。若贵方拟搜查该处，我建议于夜间并由后门执行行动。于某在汉冶萍煤矿公司（Han-Ya-Ping Coal Coy.）任职，鸦片来自上游地区。其子在卫生局工作，招揽了许多主顾。

（签名）乔敬济（Chiao Ching Chi），别名子南（Tsz Nan），
中国禁烟协会会员

报纸上用红墨水标记的部分，显示了高玉堂（Kao Yu Tong）回复禁烟协会的电文中所述的禁烟方法。

Made by C.S.I. M. T. Ching Forwarded by Maguire CI

Sir,
With reference to the attached letter and from enquiries made
by the undersigned it ascertained that there is no such a number
1101 in Sinza Road and no No.12 Yu Ching Li Alleyway as the latter
was given to be the writer's address. Efforts were made with a
view to locate the writer in the National Anti-Opium Association as
it is written in the letter that the writer is a member of the
same association but no material information could be obtained.

Yours obediently,
M. T. Chung
C.S.I.

D. O. "B" Division

先生：

关于所附信件，并经具名人调查，查明新闸路并无1101号这一门牌，亦无“余庆里12号”这一弄堂，而后者被列为写信人的地址。鉴于信中写明写信人为全国禁烟协会会员，我方曾努力在该协会内寻找写信人，但未能获得任何实质性信息。
